text:
Noah Rivera: Quick follow-up from the design sync 5
We need a compact, consistent validation strategy for console forms. Proposal below.

Evelyn Chen: Nice. Can we separate realtime field validation (on blur) vs submit-time checks? Realtime for syntax, submit for business rules.

Roberto Diaz: Agreed. Realtime = inline microcopy + subtle icon. Submit-time = top summary that optionally collapses on mobile. Summary should list actionable items, not just errors.

Ava Singh: On required markers: instead of asterisk overload, what about a small "Required" pill for critical fields and a single global note for the rest? Saves visual noise on dense admin pages.

Noah Rivera: I like the pill idea for critical fields (API key, billing email). For general inputs we leave a global note: "Fields marked are required". Important: never rely on color alone.

accessibility-bot: A11y reminder: all error text must be programmatically associated with the input (aria-describedby). Use role=alert or aria-live for inline updates. Ensure focus management moves to the summary when submission fails.

Evelyn Chen: Delete flow nit: current modal reads "This action cannot be undone" but people skim. Suggest tiered confirmation: small deletes -> inline undo toast. medium -> modal with a checkbox. big -> typed confirm (resource name). Example copy: 
```
Modal title: Remove Integration
Body: Removing this integration will stop all syncs and delete associated metadata.
Checkbox: I understand this cannot be undone.
Primary: Remove integration
```
Only require typed confirm for org-level deletions.

Roberto Diaz: UX detail: if we use typed confirm, pre-populate the resource name in a readonly field and require user to type it in a separate input. That prevents accidental copy/paste.

Ava Singh: Error copy conventions: short problem + why + remediation. e.g., "Email invalid 1 use lowercase, include domain (example@company.com)". Avoid cryptic validators like "pattern mismatch".

Noah Rivera: Mobile behavior: collapse the summary behind a banner that expands into list items. Each item anchors into the field and opens keyboard. Save vertical space.

accessibility-bot: Keyboard users: ensure the summary links are tabbable and focus moves to the target field. For screen readers, announce number of errors on submit: "Form contains 2 errors".

Evelyn Chen: One more: visual density variant for tables with inline edit. In-row errors should appear as compact tooltips with icons and an overall row-level indicator to avoid layout shift.

Roberto Diaz: Can someone add these rules to the components docs? I'll implement the pill marker and aria-describedby helpers in the design tokens. @Evelyn can you mock the mobile collapse? @Ava can you run copy through content review?

Noah Rivera: I'll create the doc with examples and code snippets. Thanks all. :thanks:
